feed_candidates/.note: one table in parts, row order of the original file; read with read_parquet('feed_candidates/*.parquet')

washes_surface.parquet.description: every BioSTEAM run of block surface: cfg_* is the process configuration sent, the other columns are the engine's result row

washes_oat.parquet.description: every BioSTEAM run of block oat: cfg_* is the process configuration sent, the other columns are the engine's result row

washes_oatfix.parquet.description: every BioSTEAM run of block oatfix: cfg_* is the process configuration sent, the other columns are the engine's result row

washes_sobol.parquet.description: every BioSTEAM run of block sobol: cfg_* is the process configuration sent, the other columns are the engine's result row

oat_tornado.parquet.description: one row per base plant (node), parameter and metric: the metric at the base, at the parameter's low and high value, and the swing; operating_days high is the engine's bound of 366 days

sobol_indices.parquet.description: first-order (Saltelli 2010) and total (Jansen) indices per wash system, metric and factor, with 95% bootstrap intervals over the N base rows; n_used counts rows where A, B and AB_i all ran

washes_feeds.parquet.description: every BioSTEAM run made for the feeds scenarios (one per distinct wash per scenario)

feed_scenarios.parquet.description: one row per scenario and downstream location: the feed, the plant, the three optima (pathway, profit $/yr, emissions t CO2e/yr, circularity), front sizes and counts

feed_candidates.parquet.description: every candidate pathway of every scenario and location, with its profit, emissions and circularity and whether it lies on each exact Pareto front

washes_mc.parquet.description: every BioSTEAM run made for the mc scenarios (one per distinct wash per scenario)

mc_scenarios.parquet.description: one row per scenario and downstream location: the feed, the plant, the three optima (pathway, profit $/yr, emissions t CO2e/yr, circularity), front sizes and counts

mc_candidates.parquet.description: every candidate pathway of every scenario and location, with its profit, emissions and circularity and whether it lies on each exact Pareto front
